title: Announcement banner + stepper two-up sprite pack (before/after & micro-interaction frames)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Produce a focused image pack for the upcoming public changelog post and quickstart docs that highlights the new onboarding stepper and announcement banner. Deliverables must include before/after two-up comparisons, micro-interaction frame sprites for the stepper states, desktop/mobile hero banners, OG/social headers, and annotated callouts for docs. Exports to include PNG, WebP, SVG sources and a Figma share link. Must meet engineering size limits and accessibility contrast guidance.
tasks: Audit current stepper artboards and identify missing states (idle, hover, focus, loading, completed)
Design two-up before/after comps showcasing previous UX vs new simplified stepper with callouts
Create sprite sheet of micro-interaction frames (6 frames per micro-interaction) and fallback GIF for blog header
Produce desktop and mobile hero banners (1600x640, 1200x630 OG) including dark-mode variants
Annotate all callouts for docs with copy-ready bullets and suggested alt text
Run accessibility contrast checks and iterate on callout colors
Export final assets (PNG 2x, WebP optimized, SVG source) and upload to CDN + add to Confluence release page
Create PR to blog repo with images and update release post draft link
Collect final sign-off from PM and engineering for bundle size and responsive breakpoints
acceptance_criteria: Image pack uploaded to the release Confluence page with Figma link and CDN paths
Two-up before/after comps show clearly labeled differences and match copy in the blog draft
Sprite sheet and GIF validated in staging blog build without layout shift
Responsive hero banners render correctly at desktop and mobile breakpoints and in dark mode
Contrast checks pass WCAG AA for all callout text and badges
Final export sizes meet engineering limits: hero <= 350KB WebP, OG <= 200KB, sprite sheet <= 120KB
PM and Eng sign-off recorded in comments with timestamp and reviewer names
comments: 2025-02-10 Maya Chen: Scoped initial asset list with PM. PM asked to prioritize social OG sizes and a small hero for the changelog email template.
2025-02-11 Luis Ortega: Comped two-up before/after in Figma; left inline notes about simplifying the stepper labels to shorten copy for mobile.

2025-02-12 Design review: Feedback from PM (Aisha Patel) - reduce number of callout badges from 4 to 3, emphasize latency/cost bullets; Eng (Noah Kim) flagged sprite size risk and requested frame count reduction from 8 to 6 per micro-interaction.
2025-02-13 Maya Chen: Iterated visuals per review. Updated color tokens to match console palette; ran contrast tool, small adjustments made to orange callout for AA compliance.

2025-02-14 Luis Ortega: Exported test sprite and GIF, uploaded to staging blog. Observed layout shift at mobile breakpoint caused by GIF height; adjusted artboard bleed and re-exported with fixed ratio.
2025-02-16 Engineering review: Noah Kim - Approved image formats and sizes. Noted that SVGs must not include embedded fonts; requested flattened text for OG SVGs. Added to PR as checklist.
2025-02-18 Aisha Patel (PM): Final review complete. Approved for release pending final CDN upload. See PR link for final assets. Signed off: Aisha P.
risks: Animated GIFs may push email client size limits; fallback to static PNG recommended for email campaign
Dark mode variants may require extra QA across platforms which could slip export schedule
SVG text flattening may increase file size for OGs; trade-off between editable vector vs smaller rasterized PNGs
notes: This asset pack is intended to live in the changelog release bundle and be reused across docs, blog, and email. Keep a single source of truth in Figma and tag exports with the release date in filenames. Avoid embedding customer data; all screenshots must be with sandbox tenant.
